headline.context: Finance chief Colette Kress takes over for now.
headline.vo: Jensen Huang has resigned as chief executive of Nvidia, the chipmaker at the centre of the AI boom. He also left its board, effective immediately, the company said on Thursday.

beats.label: years leading Nvidia, which he co-founded
beats.vo: Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and led it for thirty-three years. The company gave no reason for his departure. Its shares closed down about four percent on Thursday.

On Sunday, Huang admitted being unfaithful to his wife. US media reported that one relationship was with a woman suspected of spying for China, which Beijing denies. Nvidia's board says it has no reason to believe national security was compromised.

beats.quote: I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years.
beats.vo: Finance chief Colette Kress is now interim chief executive, while the board searches for a permanent successor. Nvidia reports its quarterly results next Tuesday.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after 33 years, Colette Kress named interim chief
caption: Jensen Huang has resigned as chief executive and board member of Nvidia, the company he co-founded in 1993. Nvidia gave no reason; Huang admitted an affair on Sunday, and US media reported links to a woman suspected of spying for China, which Beijing denies. Finance chief Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor.
